thread:
Elena (Finance): VertexLabs sent invoice INV-7719 for $28,600. AP bounced it: no PO on header and vendor charged overage for extra inference hours. PDF attached: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/VL/inv-7719.pdf

Noah (Accounts Payable): Coupa error: NO_PO + MATCH_FAIL. System shows invoice line: '500k inference-minutes overage'. Our PO-8044 covers base usage only.

billing-bot: Alert: usage spike detected on account redwood-prod between 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-05. Estimated extra units: 520,000. Ticket created: USG-5571

Irina (Procurement): Which PO should this invoice be against? Contract SOW mentions PO-8044 but overage needs pre-approval per clause 7.3. If vendor billed without pre-approval we might dispute the overage.

Sam (Vendor Ops): I already asked VertexLabs for backup: usage report, meter IDs, and whether overage was auto-billed. They replied: meter shows 503,200 minutes and our portal auto-invoiced per contract. They didn't include PO on header.

Elena (Finance): Two issues: (1) missing PO prevents routing, (2) invoiced overage may be disputable if not pre-approved. Let's not pay the overage until we confirm. @Noah hold payment and open dispute.

Noah (Accounts Payable): Opening dispute now. AP ticket AP-12021 created and placed on hold. Link: https://ap.redwood.internal/ticket/AP-12021

billing-bot: Dispute logged: AP-12021 linked to USG-5571 and contract clause 7.3.

Sam (Vendor Ops): VertexLabs asks if we can apply PO-8044 to the invoice and then credit the overage amount pending reconciliation. They prefer to avoid a formal dispute.

Irina (Procurement): We can apply PO-8044 to match the invoice header for processing, but we need a procurement exception note documenting why overage charged without approval and expected resolution timeline. If vendor issues a credit memo later, AP can adjust.

Elena (Finance): Agreed. Vendor-first: ask VertexLabs to (A) reissue invoice with PO=PO-8044 and include detailed usage CSV, (B) flag overage line as 'pending dispute/credit'. If they won't, we'll keep AP-12021 and escalate to vendor management.

Noah (Accounts Payable): Holding payment. ETA for dispute response from vendor: 48 hours per their SLA. I'll keep AP-12021 open and expedite once we have corrected invoice or credit memo.

Sam (Vendor Ops): Sent vendor template and requested reissue. They confirmed they'll send usage CSV and a reissued invoice referencing PO-8044 within 24 hours.

Elena (Finance): Action items recap: (1) @Sam request reissued invoice with PO-8044 + usage backup; (2) @Irina prepare exception memo template for procurement signoff if we accept temporary match; (3) @Noah keep AP-12021 on hold and await vendor docs.
